proposition: A non-Member-State/non-institution intervener may appeal only where the General Court decision directly affects the intervener's own legal situation; ECCA did not establish that condition and its appeal was dismissed as inadmissible.
scope_note: The holding is limited to Article 56 appellate standing and admissibility. It does not decide the substantive pesticide-regulatory grounds or independently validate any scientific proposition concerning chlorpyrifos-methyl.
